surface_mechanism_description: The SiCl4 reaction with the hydroxylated SiO2 surface was monitored by the disappearance of O-H stretching vibrations and appearance of Si-Cl stretching vibrations. These results revealed that the SiCl4 reaction completely removed the isolated hydroxyl species and left a small fraction of hydrogen-bonded hydroxyl species. The H2O reaction was studied by observing the disappearance of the Si-Cl stretching vibration and the appearance of the O-H stretching vibration. The pyridine catalyzes the H2O reaction by hydrogen bonding to the incoming H2O reactant.
